name: rosetta-increment-a-numerical-string
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

increment(text: string) -> string => "{int.parse(text) + 1}"

huge(text: string) -> string => "{bigint.parse(text) + 1n}"

write_line(increment("1234"))
write_line(huge("999999999999999999999999"))
